title: z-harness event (events.jsonl line)
description: A single event line as emitted by scripts/log-event.sh after compat.py adds schema_version. Top-level keys are {ts, run, kind, optional slug, schema_version} plus payload fields merged at top level (kind-specific). Aligns with the actual shape log-event.sh writes today; do not nest payload.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC with Z suffix only (no offset notation). Matches `date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ`.

run.description: Run id (free-form string, conventionally <ISO-stamp>-<slug>). Note: field name is `run`, not `run_id` — aligned with log-event.sh line 87.

kind.description: Event kind, e.g. dispatch_start, dispatch_end, task_done, schema_validation_error.

slug.description: Plan slug. Present only when Z_HARNESS_SLUG was set at emit time (log-event.sh lines 88-89).

schema_version.description: Added by runtime/compat.py before emit. Direct callers of log-event.sh that bypass compat.py will produce events that fail validation — this is the migration signal.
